evals.prompt: Check these Input component colors for WCAG: placeholder Grey/400 #9CA3AF on white, border Grey/300 #D1D5DB on white, label Grey/900 #111827 on white, focus ring Primary/500 #3B82F6 on white.
evals.expected_output: Computed ratios: #9CA3AF 2.54:1 fails text; #D1D5DB 1.47:1 fails 1.4.11 for the input border as a component boundary; #111827 passes; #3B82F6 3.68:1 passes 3:1 for a focus indicator but would fail as normal text. Each with SC references and fixes.
assertions: Grey/400 is computed at 2.54:1 and fails for text
Grey/300 border is computed at 1.47:1 and flagged under 1.4.11
Primary/500 is computed at 3.68:1 with the correct pass or fail by use
Ratios come from computation, not estimation

evals.prompt: Audit our Figma signup screen for accessibility before development.
evals.expected_output: A design-stage audit covering visual, structure and content criteria, with keyboard and screen reader layers marked not tested and developer annotations for expected semantics.
assertions: Criteria that cannot be assessed in Figma are marked not tested
